title: Верный Гиндзиро
alt: Непоколебимый Гиндзиро Trusty Ginjiro 硬派銀次郎
description: After the death of his elder brother, Ginjiro Yamazaki appoints himself his parents' protector. After transferring to a new school, he gets into a lot of fights. (Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)

en:
After the death of his elder brother, Ginjiro Yamazaki appoints himself his parents' protector. After transferring to a new school, he gets into a lot of fights.



(Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)
